title: Concept: YARN ResourceManager UI is reachable without authentication
description: The ResourceManager view is the scheduling map of the cluster: node addresses, queue names and the applications that own them. Queue names usually mirror the organisational structure, and the node list is the inventory of the Hadoop estate.
applicability: Responses from a Hadoop cluster that serves the ResourceManager on a reachable interface.
risk: The caller maps the cluster nodes and queues, and can reach the scheduler API that accepts applications.
